first_summary: The rot in these files is concentrated in two evals.json cases whose expected answers rest on facts the 2.1.295 catalog reversed. Case 8 (and the matching clause in case 2) asserts a Haiku 200K wall that is now a 1M window with a 100K price cliff. Case 4 asserts the Agent tool has no effort parameter, which is now false. The evals README repeats the 200K claim at line 38, and its case and query counts and its "current" measured-results rows no longer match the files they describe. The inherit/reviewer, inspector/sonnet-high and haiku-lexical-collision cases are confirmed by the probes and should survive the rewrite. The trigger queries are cost-worded throughout, with no speed-framed positives.
critic_summary: The first pass caught the main stale facts (200K wall, no Agent effort param, case 8) but missed the wrong case and query counts, several repeated or provenance claims and most still-true-keep items, and it over-flagged user-voice trigger queries as objective defects.
